title: I Reported the Stairwell Bike With the Serial on the No-Storage Sign

parts.text: A locked bike blocked the stair at 7:02 a.m. under a NO STORAGE IN EGRESS sign. I was forty-seven, tenant, holding a still of the serial. Super Mark said it was a minute. Minute is a word egress uses when a serial exists. I reported the serial, the sign, and the blocked landing. Fire safety tagged the bike. Mark minutes elsewhere. The stairwell finally looks like stairs, which is to say empty enough to leave. Nobody thanked me, which is how you know a policy finally works. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: The egress sign had a locked serial on it — Part 1/1
social.description: Blocked landing, a tagged bike, a minute that was not. Has storage ever been a fire stair?
